digest.component_or_area: code_health metrics composition and analyzer integration
propositions: Lizard and jscpd adapter outputs are not currently consumed by any registered code_health metrics, making the adapters dead code despite working implementations
The metrics evaluation context must cache analyzer invocations by producer name to ensure each external tool (scc, lizard, jscpd) runs at most once per metrics command invocation
Missing or unavailable analyzer tools must yield an honest Unavailable reason naming the missing producer rather than zero values or generic error strings
Python and Go interface tests must assert loc, complexity, and duplication metric values through the real metrics entry point when all tools are available
Core imports must remain dependency-free with no hard requirement on lizard, scc, or jscpd; all external tools are optional and loaded only when metrics are evaluated
